A.why: True A-line skirt and a pretty pendant, but ivory and beige dominate (reads linen, not golden epic), and the wine shoulder cubes read as pauldrons from above.
A.fix: Replace the wine shoulder blocks with slim sleeves, make the bodice or an overskirt gold, and raise the crown with a Neon gem.

B.why: Rich crimson and gold reads epic and distinct, with a stepped flaring hem and a tiara, but full-width slab sleeves and a plaque bodice make it broad at the top.
B.fix: Slim the sleeves to the arm, reshape the gold plaque into a V or corset bodice, widen the lowest skirt tier, and add Neon crown gems.

C.why: Best crown of the wave, but below the waist it is a straight column with a box hem: it reads as a king's robe or coat, not a gown.
C.fix: Build a real bell skirt from the hip (at least 1.5 times the hip width at the hem), slim the sleeves, and turn the black chest square into a spreading crack or stain.

D.why: The octagonal halo is the best glow idea and the colours are epic, but the body is a pagoda of full-width boxes with no waist, standing on a plinth-like base.
D.fix: Cut the upper body to slim sleeves and a fitted bodice, keep the tiers only on the skirt, and turn the dark plinth into a fabric hem. Make the halo Neon.

E.why: The hoop-cage skirt and diagonal sash are inventive, but the empty cage reads as a crate, the hip rim makes the hip the widest point, and the ivory block torso is bulky.
E.fix: Fill the hoops with fabric panels (leave a few bare struts as the souring), narrow the torso and sleeves, and move the width from the hip to the hem.

F.why: The most gown-like: a pleated, ruffled bell from the hip, a sun-ray crown with a medallion and lace cuffs, and unmistakably gold. But it is one muddy ochre tone, with little wine and no souring, and the sleeves are block width.
F.fix: Brighten the gold and bring in wine red and creeping shade-black, slim the upper sleeves and shrink the cuff frills, and add Neon to the crown medallion and a waist gem.

notes: No candidate solved the slim-sleeve brief: every one still has shoulder-width block sleeves that read broad from the pitch-50 camera. F has the best skirt and crown and B the best palette, so the ideal next wave is F's silhouette in B's wine-and-gold, with C's or D's crown and halo for height, and Neon on two or three small parts. Almost no candidate shows the dream souring yet.
